correctness.rationale: Equations (6)–(8) are exact conjugacy and Taylor expansion. The strict critical drift, monotone odd iteration and uniform small-neighborhood entry imply u_j->0 uniformly after bounded initial steps. Reciprocal-square variables satisfy r_{j+1}=(1-2a/k)r_j+1/3+error, with r_j=O(k) and total error o(k), so a locally uniform Riemann sum determines r_k/k. The exact equilibrium-cycle parameterization independently yields the a>0 lower branch. The a<=0 and a=0 cases, normalizations, signs and probability-window orientation were checked. Finite diagnostics (279 pass) are supplementary, not proof.
